actions.text:
Hi David — thanks for reaching out and for the clear project brief. This sounds like an interesting fit and I’d be interested in discussing further.

A few quick notes/questions before we proceed:
1) Budget & timeline — $8,000 for a 6-week fixed-price engagement is within scope depending on the final spec. Could you confirm whether that budget includes post-launch support/bugfixes or if that will be scoped separately?
2) Start date — you mentioned “Next Monday.” I can be available to start then if we confirm scope and contract details this week. If that’s still the plan, what time would you like to kick off?
3) Tech & access — I can work with a React frontend + Python/Flask backend. Please share any API docs, example data, and any existing code/components you want to reuse.
4) NDA & onboarding links — I noticed the links in the message point to non-standard ports and domains (e.g. a :9020/:9030 host). For security reasons I won’t sign legal documents or enter sensitive details on an unverified domain. Could you either:
   - Send the NDA via DocuSign under a verified docu sign domain, or
   - Attach a PDF of the NDA here in the FreelanceHub thread (or email it to my address jordan.mitchell@email.com) so I can review it securely?
5) Quick call — happy to do a 30-minute call to align on scope and next steps. I’m available (CST) on:
   - Tue Apr 4, 14:00–16:00
   - Wed Apr 5, 09:00–12:00
   - Thu Apr 6, 10:00–12:00
If none of those times work, send a couple of alternatives and I’ll accommodate.

If you can confirm the items above and provide API/docs, I’ll prepare a short project proposal and timeline. Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer | TechCorp Inc.
jordan.mitchell@email.com
